description: This file provides utility functions for handling TLS certificates and private keys, including serialization and deserialization in PEM and DER formats, using OpenSSL functions within the Android project.

methods.name: fromPem
methods.description: Template function to read PEM formatted data into an OpenSSL object.

methods.name: fromDer
methods.description: Template function to read DER formatted data into an OpenSSL object.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Template function to serialize an OpenSSL object into a byte vector.

methods.name: deserializeCertificate
methods.description: Deserializes a certificate from PEM or DER format based on the specified format.

methods.name: serializeCertificate
methods.description: Serializes a certificate into PEM or DER format based on the specified format.

methods.name: deserializeUnencryptedPrivatekey
methods.description: Deserializes an unencrypted private key from PEM or DER format.

methods.name: serializeUnencryptedPrivatekey
methods.description: Serializes a private key into PEM or DER format.
